notes: Read all 127 source lines line by line before editing. Every line is accounted for below; the two TanStack Query subscriptions (keys, query fns, refetch intervals), the four queued/processing/ready/failed counts, the badge logic, the compression block, and the export-queue block are preserved.

L1 `import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'`: no native module. Replaced by the inlined useNativeTranslation shim (FSMHealthPanel/GeofencesPage precedent). Every web t() call passes the English copy AS the key with no default, so the shim returns the key verbatim; this file uses no interpolation.
L2 `import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'`: used directly — react-query is in the native manifest and the ServiceStatus port already drives refetchInterval polling queries this way.

L3-6 `import { Archive, TrendingUp, HardDrive, BarChart3, Clock, Activity, CheckCircle, XCircle } from 'lucide-react'`: no native renderer. Card/header icons -> shared native SemanticIcon glyphs (Archive->archive, TrendingUp->trendUp, HardDrive->hardDrive, BarChart3->analytics, Clock->clock, Activity->activity, CheckCircle->success, XCircle->error). The status-cell icons returned by the ported helpers.getStatusIcon become inline severity-tinted glyphs (CheckCircle->'\u2713', AlertTriangle->'\u26A0', XCircle->'\u2715').

L7 `import { Grid } from '@/components/layout'`: -> a wrapping native flex row (styles.metricGrid, width:'48%' cells, justify space-between, rowGap gap-3) honouring the mobile `cols.default: 2` (MotorEfficiencyInsights mobile-default approach). Used for both the 4 MetricCards (web L87) and the 4 StatCards (web L103).

L8 `import { Badge, DataTable, type Column } from '@/components/ui'`: no native module. Badge -> inline variant pill (info/warning/neutral surfaces from theme tokens + a blue info literal); DataTable -> inline ExportJobsTable (header + rows keyed by web keyExtractor j.id, compact padding, DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE=25 pager matching the web DataTable default, emptyMessage contract). `Column<T>` carried as a native-pragmatic subset (key/header/render/sortable/align); the web sort/resize/column-menu/virtualization have no native analogue.
L9 `import { MetricCard, StatCard } from '@/components/data-display'`: -> the ported native MetricCard / StatCard (color=green/cyan/purple neon variants; icon ReactNode).
L10 `import { RadialGauge } from '@/components/charts'`: -> the ported native RadialGauge (value/max/label/unit/color/size).

L11 `import { Skeleton, EmptyState } from '@/components/feedback'`: Skeleton -> inline placeholder bars (styles.skeletonSm h-32=128, skeletonLg h-48=192); EmptyState -> inline centred muted message (styles.emptyState/emptyText, web py-16/text-center/max-w-md).

L12 `import { fmtInt, fmtPercent } from '@/lib/numberFormat'`: -> useFormatPrefs().fmt. fmtInt(v)=fmt(v,0); fmtPercent(v)=`${fmt(v)}%` (settings-driven global precision + locale), via the module-level fmtPercent(value,fmt) helper.

L13 `import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/dateFormat'`: -> the ported native DateTime component ('full' variant) rendered in the created_at cell (same Intl 'Apr 4, 2026, 2:30 AM' output via the pure path, no settings hook).

L14 `import { getCompressionStats, getExportJobs as getDevtoolsExportJobs } from '@/api/devtools'`: -> the native devtools module getCompressionStats / getExportJobs (same /system/compression-stats and /export/jobs endpoints; getExportJobs() called arg-less, default limit=50 offset=0).

L15 `import type { ExportJobSummary } from '@/api/types'`: imported from the native devtools module instead — its interface is byte-identical to api/types and shares type identity with getExportJobs' return, avoiding structural friction. CompressionStats is inferred from getCompressionStats so no extra type import is needed.
